title: .NET: Building GodotSharp is broken in current `master` branch
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.4.dev (4364ed6ccd001cbfe7cb781d074100695c878d90)
- Not reproducible in 4.4.dev6 and earlier

### System information

Fedora 41, .NET 8.0.111

### Issue description

```
./bin/godot.blabla --generate-mono-glue modules/mono/glue
./modules/mono/build_scripts/build_assemblies.py --godot-output-dir ./bin
```
